verdict.rationale: Attio Workflows is a native visual automation builder where workspace members define sequences of automated actions, triggered by events such as a new deal record being created. Actions include enrichment, scoring and routing, and developers can add custom triggers and steps that subscribe to external events. Its AI can also build workflows from a described goal. missing for 10: a documented catalog of native trigger types beyond the deal-created example, explicit documentation of conditional/branching rule logic, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Attio Workflows is a visual automation builder that lets workspace members define sequences of automated actions
Trigger when a new deal record is created.
When a new deal is created ... Web Agent Enrich the record with web research. ... Custom Agent Score the lead and route to the right AE.
Add custom triggers and steps to the Attio Workflows builder: subscribe to external events or call external APIs as part of a workflow run.
Ask Attio to build workflows for you just by describing the goal.
